positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: US Bank is introducing Tesla Lease-to-Loan Digital Experience. As part of this, US Bank will take the Tesla customer experience to the next level by delivering a best-in-class, digital solution to finance their personal Tesla vehicle. Specifically, US Bank Tesla customers will be given the options of how to handle the maturity of their Tesla Lease including new options to secure online US Bank leading to finance the purchase of their current Tesla.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: The Citi bank pre-login marketing pages are redesigned into responsive designs to enable prospects and customers to learn more about Citi products, features and serves as a gateway to online acquisition. The redesign keeps up to date with the latest web tech and experiences to follow best practices as well as trends where strategically applicable. Ensuring that all products are approached with the vision of potential expansion and reuse is a must to create efficiencies for domains within the web. Rapid adoption of strategic priorities are done so through consulting or assisting other domains across the organization.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: The new Preferred Rewards and Banking Rewards Wealth Management Programs being created as part of this project will recognize participating clients with special services and pricing benefits considering the assets of "Bank of America". Preferred Rewards service will be Opt-in/ Opt-out to the customer based on eligibility criteria. The new Scheduling an appointment offers customer a convenient way to save time. Customers can tell in advance what they’d like to talk about so that the specialist can prepare. Customers can get selected specialists on their individual questions on their convenient day and time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Health Care Service Corporation (HCSC) is the largest customer-owned health insurance company in the United States. HCSC offers a wide variety of health and life insurance products and related services, through its operating divisions and subsidiaries. The portal is completely developed using Java/ J2EE technologies with Spring, Hibernate, and Web Services on Web Sphere Application Server on Linux Platform.

positions.title: Jr. Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Automotive Warranty and Concern management system is a web project developed to address
Warranty Concerns of Global Automotive Companies by reducing the amount of manual processing needed for claims. The product aims at improving internal competencies in terms of software engineering, automation, productivity and related development processes through internal projects in the areas of Web computing and traditional software development and maintenance processes.
